text:
sqlpipe v2.0 is out with a breaking API change, a new incremental mode, and faster Parquet output.

The `/v2/users` response no longer returns a single `name` field. It now returns `first_name` and `last_name`, making user records easier to parse, sort, and map into downstream systems. Update any clients, transforms, or schemas that still read `name` before upgrading.

This release also adds `--incremental`, letting sqlpipe process only new or changed data instead of rerunning full exports every time. It is useful for scheduled syncs, large datasets, and lower-cost pipelines.

Parquet writes are now about 40% faster, reducing export time for analytics workloads without changing output format.
